mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to lower expected future returns and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth exceeds 2% in the prior quarter, it signals robust economic momentum, boosting corporate earnings expectations and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 exceeds 2% growth in the previous quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or GDP growth is followed by a recession within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the 2-month moving average for INDPRO indicates improving supply chain efficiency and production capacity, reducing supply-side bottlenecks and enhancing corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses above its 2-month moving average
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) despite the supply improvement.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) surpasses its 1-month high, it signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or unemployment rises sharply in the following months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high demand (GDPC1 > 3%) and supply (INDPRO > 118) growth signals an overheating economy, prompting market corrections and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the high indicators.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous high demand (GDPC1 > 3%) and supply (INDPRO > 118) growth overcorrects, leading to market overvaluation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) in such regimes, or the interaction effect diminishes over time.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment (UNRATE below 4.5%) signals a robust labor market, driving consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which results in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or unemployment rises sharply within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in the federal funds rate and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal dual upward pressure on discount rates and inflation expectations, creating market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both exceed their 3-month moving averages
failure_condition: Rank IC > 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the dual signals.
